summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the October 8, 2026 results of a continued Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting on a by-law amendment to rename the company Saentra Forge S.p.A. About 28 holders representing 38,811,108 shares (80.49% of capital) and 98,516,262 votes (91.28% of voting rights) participated. The proposal received 53,307,711 votes for and 20,776,225 against, but failed because Italian law and the articles require approval by more than 50% of total voting rights. The legal name remains Genenta Science; management reaffirms its strategic transition toward becoming an industrial consolidator targeting aerospace, defense, and biotechnology/biosecurity businesses. Watch for follow-on name-change proposals and acquisition announcements.
